components.text: While wearing this new armour, you have felt it growing, trying to assist you with various tasks it has seen you perform. It seems to be able to perform in a number of areas, but its growth is limited, and trying to do everything at once is quite fruitless.

Perhaps multiple specialised sets may be a good idea? Of course, you'll have to train it carefully if you want more than a smattering of poorly-directed benefits.
Fortunately, there is a Ritual (Sound of the Cleansing Soul / Penance of the Leaden Soul) that will assist with training, and another (Ritual of Living Evolution) that will imbue your armour with a greater ability to grow.
